summary: Diagno is a small CPA practice founded in 1996 in Southport, Queensland, with a Melbourne office, offering accounting, tax, forecasting, SMSF and outsourced CFO. Director Kris Fothergill has spoken publicly about running the firm remotely and reducing key person dependency. P&J Siggins joined the firm around December 2024. LinkedIn lists Xero and a team split across Australia and the Philippines.

hooks.text: Kris's INTHEBLACK interview and CPA podcast on reducing key person dependency and running a remote-friendly team: automation of reconciliation fits a team built to work without one person as the bottleneck.
Outsourced CFO and forecasting are core services, so time spent reconciling cuts into the advisory work clients pay for.
P&J Siggins joining Diagno and the Gold Coast plus Melbourne offices: bringing acquired client books onto one reconciliation process.

risks.text: Kris said bookkeeping is on the firm's 'to-don't' list, so Diagno may not do much transactional reconciliation itself; angle should be CFO-support and month-end review, not bookkeeping.
Very small firm (LinkedIn lists 6 employees; some of the team in the Philippines); limited budget and volume.
Podcast and INTHEBLACK interviews are from 2021, so personal details are dated.

gaps: No recent (2026) posts by Kris Fothergill or Stephen Robie found; no Facebook or Instagram activity found.
Xero partner status not confirmed from a primary source; Xero appears only in a LinkedIn tech-stack summary.
Date of the P&J Siggins announcement page is not shown; ABN Lookup date used.
